dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Features multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped light-tan motifs with perimeter gradients transitioning from a dark-brown exterior to a high-intensity tan interior; the most defined geometries are found in the three primary rings on the lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, concentrated high-intensity pixel clusters is present in the anterior dorsal and neck regions, transitioning to a lower density of larger, more diffuse clusters toward the posterior body segments.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest lateral macro-annuli form a wide obtuse triangle, while a secondary alignment of three smaller motifs creates a roughly linear configuration along the mid-lateral axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized region of high-contrast reddish-pink pixels with irregular margins situated on the superior edge of the caudal flipper.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible interlocking chain-like configuration consisting of three distinct circular high-contrast motifs located on the posterior-lateral flank.
